translations.title: Trimebutine Maleate 200 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for acid reflux and hiatal hernia; for the digestive problems that come with gastritis, duodenitis or ulcers — stomach pain, indigestion, nausea and vomiting; and for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon.
translations.usage: Adults take 100–200 mg three times a day, before meals. The dose may be adjusted to suit your age and symptoms.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have an inherited problem with lactose metabolism, such as galactose intolerance. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you have ever reacted to Yellow No. 4 (tartrazine).

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, irritable bowel symptoms
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Inherited lactose metabolism disorders; pregnancy and breastfeeding
summaryTable.Why this one: A digestive aid that regulates gut movement
